card.name: Digits inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, most often 0, inside or at the start of a number, such as in counts, votes, percentages, doses and decimals. It also fires on a letter standing in for a number.

modes.label: Zero in counts and rates
modes.description: The digit 0 starts or sits inside a count, vote total or percentage.

modes.label: Digit inside a longer number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a dose, voltage or decimal figure.

modes.label: Variable standing for a number
modes.description: A letter used as a number placeholder in a math sentence.
